description: CMF Watch 3 Pro was launched in India on Wednesday as the company's latest flagship smartwatch. Priced at Rs. 7,999 in the country, the new wearable enters a crowded price segment, which is flooded with numerous offerings. I got to use the smartwatch for a few days, and here are my first impressions of the CMF Watch 3 Pro, which features a premium-looking metal frame and detachable straps. The watch is quite light to wear and feels great to touch. Moreover, its display is bright enough for indoor usage.
title: CMF Watch 3 Pro First Impressions

description: Astronomers discovered a faint atmosphere around (612533) 2002 XV93 using a stellar occultation. The finding challenges current theories, as such small, cold bodies should not retain gas, hinting at recent activity like impacts or ice volcanism.
title: Astronomers Discover Trans-Neptunian Object With Atmosphere in Outer Solar System

description: Pragmata tells a familiar father-daughter story with a science-fiction spin, and it treads a setting seen in games before. But where it borrows established ideas and aesthetics, it innovates gameplay fundamentals. Pragmata combines slow, methodical third-person shooting with simple but high-stakes grid puzzles for a fresh-feeling and often frenetic experience.
title: Pragmata Review: The Bright Side of the Moon

description: Samsung has started rolling out the stable One UI 8.5 update to supported Galaxy devices in South Korea. The update is currently reaching the Galaxy S25 series, Galaxy S25 FE, Galaxy Z Fold 7, and Galaxy Z Flip 7, with more devices and regions expected later. One UI 8.5 brings Galaxy S26 AI features such as Agentic AI, Creative Studio, smarter Bixby tools, and AI-powered photo editing. The update also introduces camera improvements, redesigned interface elements, privacy upgrades, enhanced Quick Share support, and new accessibility features.
title: Samsung's One UI 8.5 Update Finally Rolls Out to Galaxy S25 Series, S24 Series, S25 FE, Z Fold 7 and Z Flip 7

description: Vivo’s FE range started off as a sub-Rs. 60,000 smartphones, but has now been promoted to a high-end premium category with its new price tag. To justify this price rise, Vivo has thrown in premium features such as wireless charging and the ability to mount a teleconverter lens on the latest X300 FE. Does this move make sense? And do the new features add real value? Read on to find out!
title: Vivo X300 FE Review: A Strong Contender With a Catch

description: YouTube now lets users effectively disable Shorts on Android and iPhone through a new zero-minute Shorts feed limit. The feature is available under the Time Management section in the YouTube app and removes the endless Shorts scrolling experience from the homepage. Shorts may still appear in search results, subscriptions, and shared links. The feature is rolling out globally and could help users reduce screen time and limit distractions. YouTube also allows users to manually ignore the limit if they want to continue watching Shorts after reaching the restriction.
title: How to Turn Off YouTube Shorts on Your Smartphone: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Adobe unveiled the productivity agent, an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered agentic tool, on Wednesday. Designed for Acrobat, the AI agent orchestrates tools and models to generate images, text, and rich content such as presentations, podcasts, and social media posts. Alongside, the company is also upgrading PDF Spaces, a collaborative space to share documents, with new sharing and publishing capabilities.
title: Adobe Unveils New Productivity Agent for Acrobat, Adds New Features to PDF Spaces

description: Colombian President Gustavo Petro said the country’s Caribbean coast could become a Bitcoin mining hub using renewable energy sources. The proposal comes as countries like Paraguay and Venezuela continue attracting mining investments linked to low-cost electricity. Except for Colombia, Bhutan is another country that has adopted Bitcoin mining and crypto payments as its daily transaction medium.
title: Colombia Seeks to Mine Bitcoin Using Surplus Renewable Energy From Country's Coastline

description: Vivo X300 Ultra was launched in India with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip and a 200-megapixel Zeiss-branded camera. The new phone is positioned as a strong rival to devices like the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra and iPhone 17 Pro Max. Here's a quick comparison to help you decide which is the better phone among the three.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra vs Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra vs iPhone 17 Pro Max: Features, Price and Specifications Compared

description: Google began rolling out the May 2026 software update for eligible Pixel smartphones on Tuesday. The latest Android 16 build for Google Pixel phones carries fixes for several system issues that were reported by users in previous iterations. For example, it patches a bug that caused wireless charging to slow down when the battery reached a certain level. The tech giant mentions issues related to the display and camera app freezing have also been fixed, while the May 2026 security update is bundled in the update, too.
title: Google's May 2026 Update for Pixel Devices Rolls Out With Fixes for Slow Wireless Charging, Screen Freezing Issues

description: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G has allegedly appeared on the Geekbench benchmarking site again. The listing for the phone tells us about some of its key specifications. It is expected to run on the Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset. It runs on Android 16 and features 5.23GB of RAM. The Galaxy A27 5G is expected to feature a 6.7-Inch display and a triple rear camera unit.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G Shows Up on Geekbench Again With Slightly Improved Performance Scores

description: Written and directed by Shaneil Deo, Dacoit: A Love Story is a Telugu action romance drama that is soon dropping on Prime Video.
title: Dacoit: A Love Story OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Adivi Sesh and Mrunal Thakur Starrer Online?

description: Vaazha II: Biopic of a Billion Bros is a coming-of-age Malayalam drama film that is finally landing on the digital screens.
title: Vaazha II: Biopic of a Billion Bros OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Malayalam Drama Film Online

description: Sony Xperia 1 VIII was briefly listed on Amazon's platform in Germany and the UK, according to a report. The listings have since been taken down, but not before revealing the price, colour options, specifications, and features of the upcoming Sony handset. The listed prices of the smartphone in the two countries reportedly included the price of the company's flagship Sony WH1000XM6 wireless headphones. The Sony Xperia 1 VIII will reportedly go on sale in the EU on June 26. It will reportedly be offered in Garnet Red, Graphite Black, and Lolite Silver colourways.
title: Sony Xperia 1 VIII Price, Sale Date Reportedly Surface Online via Amazon Listing

description: Microsoft’s Phone Link app could become a target for threat actors if a connected Windows PC is infected with malware. According to security researchers, an ongoing campaign potentially targets victims with a remote access trojan (RAT) called CloudZ. It reportedly compromises systems and can intercept sensitive information synced between smartphones and PCs when using the Phone Link app.
title: CloudZ RAT Malware Could Exploit Microsoft Phone Link App to Access Messages and OTPs, Researchers Warn

description: The milestone came as Samsung’s shares rallied 14 percent on Wednesday, making it only the second Asian firm after Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. to hit the mark. Samsung’s gain also boosted the Kospi benchmark by more than 6 percent, driving it above the 7,000 level for the first time.
title: Samsung Hits $1 Trillion Valuation, Joining TSMC in Elite Club

description: A marketing image of the Realme 16T 5G has leaked online, indicating that the handset will launch in India soon. The render shows the phone in blue and red colour options with a square-shaped rear camera module. The Realme 16T 5G is likely to feature a larger battery and improved rear camera capabilities. It will arrive as a successor to the Realme 15T. It could ship with a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset paired with up to 8GB onboard RAM and up to 256GB onboard storage.
title: Realme 16T 5G Tipped to Launch in India Soon as Leaked Marketing Image Suggests Design, Colourways

description: Kelp DAO plans to migrate rsETH to Chainlink following the $292 million exploit tied to its LayerZero-powered infrastructure. The move comes as tensions between Kelp DAO and LayerZero continue over the cause of the breach and security setup.
title: Kelp DAO Migrates rsETH to Chainlink After $292 Million Hack as Dispute With LayerZero Intensifies

description: Apple has reportedly reached a settlement in the class action lawsuit filed by iPhone owners over the Cupertino-based tech giant's claims on the capabilities of its “Apple Intelligence” suite of tools, according to a report citing a court filing. The tech giant could reportedly pay $250 million (about Rs. 2,367 crore) in total in compensation to a select group of iPhone owners in the US. Owners of iPhone 16, iPhone 16 Plus, iPhone 16 Pro, and iPhone 16 Pro Max, along with owners of iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max, who bought their handset between June 2024 and March 2025, will be eligible to receive compensation from Apple.
title: Apple Agrees to Pay $250 Million Settlement to iPhone 16, iPhone 15 Pro Owners Over AI Claims

description: Apple may allow users to choose third-party AI models across Apple Intelligence features on iPhones, iPads, and Macs, according to a new report. The feature is reportedly planned for iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27 later this fall. Users could select AI providers through the Settings app for features such as Siri, Writing Tools, and Image Playground. Apple is also said to be testing integrations with Google and Anthropic. The report further claims Siri could support different AI voices and a redesigned standalone app.
title: Apple's iOS 27 Update Said to Add Option to Choose Third-Party AI Providers for Siri

description: Vivo X300 Ultra was launched in India on Wednesday, more than a month after its debut in China. The handset has been introduced alongside the Vivo X300 FE. It sports a 6.82-inch AMOLED screen with a 144Hz refresh rate. Positioned at the summit of Vivo’s flagship smartphone lineup in the country, it comes with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip under the hood. Vivo has equipped the handset with a 200-megapixel Zeiss-backed camera system with advanced telephoto capabilities. The Vivo X300 Ultra packs a 6,600mAh battery.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra Launched in India With 200-Megapixel Zeiss Camera, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo X300 FE has been launched in India as the fourth model in the company’s flagship lineup, which also includes the Vivo X300, Vivo X300 Pro, and Vivo X300 Ultra. The new handset is set to go on sale in the country soon via Flipkart, Amazon, and the Vivo India online store. The new Vivo X300 FE is powered by Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, which is built on a 3nm process. Moreover, the latest Vivo X300 series smartphone is backed by a 6,500mAh battery. It also carries a triple rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter.
title: Vivo X300 FE Launched in India With Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC, Zeiss-Tuned 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Features

description: OpenAI, on Tuesday, announced that it is updating the default artificial intelligence (AI) model in ChatGPT. The default model is available to everyone when they first open the website or the app, including those on the free tier. So far, this experience has been powered by the GPT-5.3 Instant, but now, the San Francisco-based AI giant is replacing it with the GPT-5.5 Instant.
title: OpenAI Upgrades ChatGPT’s Default AI Model to GPT-5.5 Instant, Adds New Capabilities

description: Oppo Reno 16 Pro will launch in China later this month. We don't know much about its arrival in markets outside China at the moment, but a new entry on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) website hints at its imminent arrival in India. It also appeared on the TKDN websites with model number CPH2863. The phone could support 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G networks. It is likely to feature a MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset and a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Pro Global Launch Could Follow Debut in China; BIS Listing Suggests It Will Also Come to India

description: CMF has unveiled the Watch 3 Pro in India with upgraded GPS tracking, AI-backed workout features, and a metal-body design. The smartwatch comes with a 60Hz AMOLED display, support for more than 120 watch faces, and compatibility with the Nothing X app. It offers Bluetooth calling, voice recording with transcription, and gesture shortcuts. Health and fitness features include sleep tracking, blood oxygen monitoring, stress tracking, and 131 sports modes. CMF says the wearable can last up to 13 days on a single charge and supports IP68 dust and water resistance.
title: CMF Watch 3 Pro With Dual-Band GPS, Up to 13 Days Battery Life Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Bitcoin traded near $81,300 on Wednesday as ETF inflows and long-term investor accumulation supported the crypto market. Analysts said institutional demand remains strong, though macro uncertainty and resistance near key levels continue to keep momentum gradual.
title: Bitcoin Holds Steady as ETF Inflows and Long-Term Buying Support Market

description: The Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 moniker has appeared on the company's website in Canada, under the list of smartwatches eligible to receive WatchOS updates, while appearing “in the service provider's device assessment software or tool” on the English and French Galaxy trade-in pages. While the listing does not reveal any specifications and features, it does seemingly confirm the smartwatch's imminent launch in select global markets. The wearable is expected to succeed last year's Samsung Galaxy Watch 8.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 Launch May Be on the Cards After Wearable Surfaces on Company's Website
OPPO K14 5G Overview: Segment’s Smoothest and Longest-Performing Smartphone Under ₹25,000

description: Xiaomi has expanded its battery upgrade programme for select older smartphones in China. Instead of limiting larger batteries to newer smartphones, the company is now offering existing users a way to extend the lifespan of their phones with upgraded battery packs. Consequently, Xiaomi 13, Xiaomi 13 Pro, and Xiaomi 13 Ultra users are eligible for higher-capacity battery replacements. The service, however, is not entirely free of cost and incurs a charge, along with limited availability.
title: Xiaomi 13 Series Now Eligible for Battery Upgrade Programme in China With Up to 500mAh Increased Capacity

description: Coinbase, the US-based cryptocurrency exchange, is laying off 14 percent of its global workforce, or roughly 700 employees. The company CEO, Brian Armstrong, announced the decision publicly on Tuesday, citing market volatility and artificial intelligence (AI) acceleration as the main reasons. This is the second layoff from the company, after it cut 18 percent of the jobs in 2022.
title: Coinbase Layoff: 14 Percent of Workforce Fired, CEO Cites Market Volatility and AI Adoption

description: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced that Microsoft is winding down its Copilot AI assistant for Xbox on mobile and Xbox consoles. Sharma, who took over as Xbox chief in February, said Copilot on Xbox did not align with where the company was headed. The Xbox boss also confirmed a leadership shuffle at the company.
title: Microsoft Retires Xbox Copilot AI Assistant on Mobile and Consoles, Confirms Xbox Leadership Changes

description: GoBoult has expanded its Bluetooth speaker lineup in India with the new Mustang GT20 and Mustang GT40 models developed in collaboration with Mustang. The speakers feature automotive-inspired designs with metallic grilles, leather-textured finishes, and Mustang branding. The GT20 delivers 20W output, while the GT40 offers 40W sound with dedicated bass and treble controls. Both models support Bluetooth 6.0, TWS pairing, USB and TF card playback, and IPX4 splash resistance. GoBoult claims up to seven hours of battery life on the GT20 and up to six hours on the GT40.
title: GoBoult Mustang GT20, Mustang GT40 Bluetooth Speakers Launched in India With Up to 40W Output and Familiar Design

description: Meta is adding new weapons to its age-detection arsenal to ensure teenagers and those under the age of 13 aren’t faking their date of birth to access the platform. The latest tool is an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered visual analysis system that goes through users’ photos and videos and picks up on cues that might reveal the true age of the user.
title: Meta to Detect Teenagers With Fake Birthdays Using AI-Powered Height, Bone Structure Analysis

description: Poco C Pad has appeared in the FCC database with the model number 2603APC14G. It is likely to arrive as the rebranded version of the recently launched Redmi Pad 2 9.7 4G. The latter features a 9.7-inch 2K display with up to 120Hz of refresh rate and runs on a Snapdragon 6s Gen 2 chipset alongside 4GB of LPDDR4x RAM, and up to 128GB of UFS 2.2 onboard storage.
title: Poco C Pad Could Arrive as Rebranded Version of Redmi Pad 2 9.7, US FCC Listing Suggests

description: Honor Play 70C has launched in China in in three colour options. It runs on the MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra chipset and features a 6.75-inch display with a 90Hz refresh rate. It has a 5,300mAh battery and measures 7.89mm in thickness. The  Honor Play 70C features a 13-megapixel rear camera unit.
title: Honor Play 70C Launched With 5,300mAh Battery, MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra Chip and Android 15: Price, Features

description: Apple may delay the launch of the standard iPhone 18, according to a new supply chain leak from China. The leak claims Apple has extended production of the iPhone 17 and increased manufacturing capacity for the handset ahead of China’s Singles’ Day sales in November. The move suggests the iPhone 17 could remain Apple’s main base model for longer than usual. Earlier reports had already suggested Apple may separate the launch schedules of its standard and premium iPhone models, with the base iPhone 18 potentially arriving in early 2027.
title: iPhone 18 Seemingly Delayed as Tipster Claims Apple Has Extended iPhone 17 Production

description: Apple will equip the rumoured 20th anniversary iPhone model with solid-state buttons, a tipster claims. The smartphone, whcih is expected to launch next year, could be marketed as the iPhone 20. Apple has reportedly completed “accurate” pressure recognition tests under gloved hands, wet hands, in extreme temperatures, and with the phone case on. Moreover, the Tim Cook-led tech giant will reportedly equip the handset with an “ultra-low power chip”, which will power the buttons, allowing the iPhone 20 to recognise pressure and provide feedback even when the handset has been turned off.
title: Apple Said to Equip 20th Anniversary iPhone With Solid-State Buttons, Dual-Layer OLED Display

description: Cognizant is said to be considering a major workforce reduction globally. In recent months, layoffs across the tech industry have accelerated, leading tech firms like Amazon, Meta, and Oracle to announce drastic workforce reductions. Cognizant, an IT consulting and outsourcing company, is reportedly the latest among them to plan significant job cuts affecting thousands of employees globally.
title: Cognizant Reportedly Eyes Major Workforce Reduction Amid AI-Led Restructuring; India May Bear Brunt

description: The Redmi Watch 6 is now available in select global markets. It was first introduced in China alongside the Redmi K90 and Redmi K90 Pro Max handsets in October 2025. The smartwatch has two variants — Redmi Watch 6 and Watch 6 NFC, both of which have begun selling in international markets like Poland, Romania, and Thailand. The Redmi Watch 6 sports a 2.07-inch AMOLED screen. It supports more than 150 sports modes and comes with dual L1 GPS antennas. The smartwatch is claimed to last up to 12 days under regular use on a single charge.
title: Redmi Watch 6 Launched Globally With 2.5D Curved AMOLED Screen, Up to 12 Days Battery Life: Price, Specifications

description: The Infinix Note 60 Pro was recently launched in India as another mid-range smartphone from the tech firm. The handset currently retails at Rs. 31,999 in the country, which is a crowded space. The smartphone is powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, which is built on a 4nm process, helping it deliver great performance for its price, which surpasses some of the more expensive handsets, too. The dual rear camera system on the Note 60 Pro is also quite capable, with crisp daytime performance and decent nighttime capturing. However, in portrait mode, the phone’s erratic snapping performance gets highlighted.
title: Infinix Note 60 Pro Review: Just Another Mid-Ranger?
